title: The 4 Best Mattress Toppers Under $150
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for mattress toppers under $150, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at mattress toppers under $150 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Sleep Innovations 4-Inch Topper
products.blurb: Key specs: 3-inch cooling gel memory foam plus 1-inch pillow top, Dual-layer construction, Removable, washable cover.
strengths: Dual-layer construction at this price point is a genuine step up from single-layer budget toppers
4-inch total height provides more correction for a firm mattress than any 3-inch option in this list
limitations: Ultra soft support variant may be too soft for back and stomach sleepers
Takes longer to fully decompress than thinner single-layer toppers
features: 3-inch cooling gel memory foam plus 1-inch pillow top

products.name: Lucid 3-Inch Gel Memory Foam Topper
products.blurb: Key specs: 3-inch gel-infused memory foam, 5-zone design, Ventilated cooling channels.
strengths: 5-zone design remains the most targeted pressure relief in this price bracket
Ventilated cooling channels are a genuine advantage over the Sleep Innovations' pillow top for hot sleepers
limitations: 3-inch depth provides less correction for a very firm mattress than the 4-inch Sleep Innovations
No removable cover, unlike the Sleep Innovations
No corner straps to prevent shifting

products.name: Linenspa Gel Memory Foam Topper
products.blurb: Key specs: 3-inch gel-infused memory foam, Plush feel, CertiPUR-US certified.
limitations: Lower foam density than the dual-layer Sleep Innovations, meaning faster compression over time
No zoned support or removable cover, the two features that differentiate the pricier options in this list
Best suited to buyers prioritizing budget headroom over maximum features
features: King and Cal King typically under $100
